claude_proposed_widenings.name: nonspell_ongoing_effect_magic_item_variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The collection includes variants whose benefit is neither a plain passive grant nor an activated ability. They apply recurring mechanical effects while the stone orbits, which needs an ongoing non-spell delivery family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Regeneration (Legendary). You regain 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour if you have at least 1 Hit Point while this white spindle orbits your head.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: variable_charge_spend_from_reaction_context
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption stones track a 20-level pool spent by the canceled spell's level. The current activation resource surface has a charge pool, but no way to bind per-use spend to the triggering spell level for a non-spell reactive item ability.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_proficiency_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Mastery changes Proficiency Bonus directly. No existing effect atom or passive grant shape represents a global PB increase.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Mastery (Legendary). Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_reservoir_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reserve stores arbitrary spells cast into the stone, preserves original caster metadata, and later releases those spells for the wearer. That is more than passive grants or a fixed activated ability sequence and needs a dedicated stored-spell item surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell.
